one_liner: Gumroad has a free, self-serve REST API with OAuth2 app registration and personal access tokens, plus an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Authorization-code OAuth with scopes; developers register apps self-serve in Settings > Advanced. A personal access token can also be generated for one's own account.
access_notes: Any Gumroad account can create an application and token; there are no plans or review queue.

evidence.quote: To create an application for general use, you'll need to build a Redirect URI handler to generate access tokens for each of your users.
We've provided the following scopes that you may request when the user authorizes your application.
no tier gates API access and any account can create an application and issue itself a token.
The Gumroad OAuth API is based around REST. We return JSON for every request, including errors.
Connect your Gumroad store to Claude. Create product drafts, check sales, and track payouts from your chat.
